change: Kryo — Round-trip the abstract Enum class token in a stream of class tokens
deployment: Complete pinned production JAR and original Maven runtime dependencies.
assumptions: JDK 8, default resolver, registration optional, a fresh codec at each end of one byte stream.

questions.observer: Record the type and index of a rejected token or the exact identities and final consumption of the whole sequence.
questions.basis: Class tokens denote the class object itself. The fourth token is the abstract Enum class, following a concrete enum token.

questions.observer: Read the four remaining identities sequentially and compare the cursor to the actual stream length.
questions.basis: The concrete enum token and primitive void token are separate from abstract Enum.
